{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display basic info
df_info = trial_df.info()

# Display first few rows
df_head = trial_df.head()

# Check for missing values
df_missing = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
df_duplicated = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Return all
(df_info, df_head, df_missing, df_duplicated)"}
